title: Admin Surface Design Guideline
summary: Decision dossier for a binding admin-surface standard: flat full-bleed composition, compact disclosure-first headers, one grid for stream entries, non-redundant sober copy, project identity, operator-grade density, bounded prose width, theme tokens, and locally hosted fonts. It includes a fully specified Activity reference, a screenshot-backed violation audit, an incremental adoption contract, the details-panel addendum, and the append-only Navigation citizenship chapter with three light/dark Tree variants, a neutral waiting-decision counter recommendation, state rules, and a follow-up slice boundary.
